Background:
<start of reference>
RELATED

HOLLAND, Mich. (WOOD) — There may be more entrepreneurs soon heading to West Michigan after business experts named Holland the best small city in the nation to start a business.

The tulip-speckled city beat out more than 1,200 other cities to earn the top spot on WalletHub's list, largely due to its access to resources, like investors and higher education assets.

"We're a place that people want to be," City Manager Keith Van Beek told 24 Hour News 8.

He said that support for new businesses is in Holland's "DNA and culture."

"We have a lot of great history and tradition of great ideas that were spawned in garages here that turned into fantastic large companies," Van Beek stated.

Eager entrepreneurs aren't the only people trying to set up shop in Holland.

"We've been trying for about two years to get downtown," said Jake Hogeboom, a broker at @Home Realty. "This was the third or fourth property that we made an offer on."

Hogeboom founded the company in Grand Haven six years ago. Months later, it expanded to the outskirts of Holland. His business outgrew that space and construction will soon wrap up on @Home Realty's new building at the corner of E. 7th Street and College Avenue.

Hogeboom said he's excited to be closer to the downtown energy.

"We love the development, we love what the city's doing (and) what the local developers are doing," he explained.

The company's new downtown location will boast a massive slide, offering transport from the second to first floor. It also features an in-house arcade.

However, the building will be much more than an adult playground. The third floor will transform into a space to support other businesses.

"We'll have 27 offices up there to rent out for smaller local businesses that just need one or two offices, that are looking to grow or start up businesses that can be a part of a building of this capacity but don't have the budget to go and get a big office in this location," Hogeboom explained.

Holland's economic development group, Lakeshore Advantage, seems to have played a big role in its WalletHub ranking. The city's access to investors as well as job growth between 2013 and 2017 helped thrust it to that No. 1 spot.
<end of reference>
Task:
Summarize the main reason why Holland, Michigan is a good place to start a business in at least 5 sentences aimed at high school students.
response_a: Holland, Michigan is a great place to start a business because of several reasons. Firstly, it has a supportive entrepreneurial community that values innovation and growth. This environment encourages young individuals to pursue their dreams and create successful ventures. Secondly, the city offers excellent resources such as investors, higher education institutions, and networking opportunities, which can help aspiring entrepreneurs turn their ideas into reality. Thirdly, Holland has a rich history of successful businesses that have been spawned from garages and turned into large companies, providing inspiration and guidance for new entrepreneurs. Fourthly, the city's vibrant downtown area is full of energy and activity, making it an attractive destination for businesses and customers alike. Finally, Lakeshore Advantage, the city's economic development group, plays a crucial role in supporting businesses and fostering growth, contributing to Holland's reputation as a great place to start a business.
response_b:
Holland, Michigan is an excellent place to start a business because of its supportive community, rich history of entrepreneurship, and numerous resources available to aspiring business owners. Here are five key reasons why:

1. Strong Community Support: Holland has a strong sense of community, with residents and local leaders eager to support new businesses. This support can take many forms, including mentorship, networking opportunities, and financial assistance. As City Manager Keith Van Beek put it, "We're a place that people want to be."
2. Entrepreneurial Tradition: Holland has a long history of entrepreneurship, with many successful businesses getting their start in the area. This tradition of innovation and creativity continues today, with a thriving startup ecosystem and a strong focus on supporting new businesses.
3. Access to Resources: Holland offers a wide range of resources for aspiring business owners, including access to investors, job growth opportunities, and higher education assets. These resources can help entrepreneurs succeed and grow their businesses.
4. Downtown Energy: Holland's downtown area is vibrant and full of energy, with a mix of historic buildings and modern businesses. This atmosphere can be inspiring for entrepreneurs, providing a dynamic environment in which to work and grow.
5. Supportive Economic Development Group: Holland's economic development group, Lakeshore Advantage, plays a crucial role in supporting new businesses. The organization provides resources, networking opportunities, and other support to help entrepreneurs succeed.

In summary, Holland, Michigan is a great place to start a business because of its supportive community, rich entrepreneurial tradition, access to resources, vibrant downtown area, and supportive economic development group. These factors make it an ideal location for aspiring business owners looking to launch and grow their businesses.

prompt: What are some strategies for dealing with an invader in a medieval castle? Please provide three of them with a single sentence each.
response_a:
1. Barricade the gates and defend with archers.
2. Set traps and ambush the intruder.
3. Negotiate surrender or escape through secret passages.
response_b:
1. Barricade: Close and barricade all entrances to prevent further access by the invader.
2. Alert the nearby forces: Summon reinforcements from neighboring castles or towns to counterattack the invader.
3. Use deception: Create a decoy or false retreat to lure the invader into a trap, where they can be ambushed or defeated.
